blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of year-round and seasonal beers on draft at the brewery. The brewery hosts events such as trivia nights, Oktoberfest celebrations, and private events including brewery tasting tours and parties. Food options include hot Bavarian pretzels and guests may bring food from other establishments.
extraNote: Registration fees and 40% of German lager sales benefit Habitat for Humanity during Oktoberfest · Free parking for BarrieHaus customers in designated lot during operating hours
